title: Deep learning classifies angle-closure mechanisms on anterior segment OCT
summary: The CMD-Net deep learning architecture was developed on 11,035 AS-OCT images from 1455 Handan Eye Study participants to classify the predominant angle-closure mechanism. Mean AUCs were 0.980 in cross-validation, 0.977 in a held-out set and 0.988 in a separate test of 228 images from 35 consecutive patients, and accuracy of 89.9% and 93.0% exceeded the best ophthalmologist (87.0% and 86.8%). Ground truth is expert image labeling, the separate test is small, and the authors note further validation is needed.
